messages:
alice: Heads-up — planning to start the schema cutover at 03:30 UTC during the quiet window. small staged backfill + index build.
deploy-bot: :information_source: Deployment scheduled: release/2026.03.21 - starting holdpoint at 03:25 UTC. To proceed, react with :thumbsup:.
ben: ack, I will monitor lockwatch and db connections.
carla: can we pin the service image to v2.17 for the rollout? want deterministic behavior for the canary.
dave: yes, pinning to v2.17.1 (sha256:abc123) — I'll push the pin to the release manifest now.
alice: thanks. deployment plan:
- 03:25 deploy-bot holdpoint (manual)
- 03:30 pause writers for tenant shard 12 for 90s quiesce
- 03:30 apply online DDL (add nullable col)
- 03:35 start backfill job with row ratecap 500 rps per shard
- 03:50 start index build on new col (concurrent)
- 04:10 monitor metrics, if lock > 500ms or backfill lag > 20m, abort and rollback

maria: what's the rollback path?
carla: if we abort: 1) stop backfill, 2) revert service pin to previous canary (v2.16), 3) kick the emergency resume script to unquiesce writers.
sre-oncall: add a DB kill-switch: `psql -c "select set_config('migration.mode','abort',true);"` — backfill workers check that flag every 15s.
ben: noted. I'll add a temporary healthcheck that fails if `migration.mode=abort` so deploy-bot will stop the rest of the rollout.
dave: small tweak — can we reduce the quiesce window to 60s? we saw edge flaps in previous run.
alice: 60s ok, but we'll extend row ratecap to 700 rps to catch up, and add a guard: if replica lag spikes > 30s we immediately pause.
carla: release notes snippet for infra: "Add onboarding column to tenant_profiles; backfill runs online with ratecap, may cause short quiesce for single shard." who writes the final note?
maria: I'll draft the note and post to #release-notes after deploy.
deploy-bot: :warning: Holdpoint reached. Waiting for manual proceed. Buttons: [Proceed] [Abort].
ben: pressing Proceed in 2m. will monitor lock histogram and PG activity.
(2 minutes later)
ben: Proceeded. deploy-bot: :rocket: Canary group started — pinned service v2.17.1.
carla: backfill worker logs look clean: `processed=1200 rows/min, errors=0`
dave: lockwatch: max_row_lock_wait=120ms, no tail-call alerts.
sre-oncall: checking replicas: tail lag steady ~5s. good.
alice: index build kicked off (concurrent). watching CPU on indexer nodes.
maria: ops question — if we see sustained 5xx from write API, do we rollback or shadow-queue writes?
carla: prefer rollback for small window. shadow queueing adds too much complexity mid-cutover.
ben: rolling metrics — 99th latency up 8% at the moment, within SLO but keep an eye.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary complete for shard 12. Proceed to staggered rollouts to other shards with same plan.
alice: hold — noticed a straggler job with 502s per-row backfill on tenant 12-134. putting a soft pause on that tenant and continuing others.
sre-oncall: if the single-tenant straggler holds locks > 3s repeatedly, we should fail that job and resume later; don't block the rest of the windows.
dave: agreed. killing the job and marking tenant for manual backfill during low traffic window.
carla: updated release-notes draft: "Hotpatch: tenant_profiles new column + backfill. One tenant (12-134) deferred due to large contiguous archival rows; manual backfill scheduled."
maria: posting the note now.
ben: final check — deploy-bot, confirm rollout completed for 3/3 canaries and staggered batches.
deploy-bot: :tada: Rollout completed. No rollbacks triggered.
alice: great work team. Follow-up: schedule a postmortem for the straggler tenant and add a heuristic to skip huge archival ranges next time.
sre-oncall: adding postmortem ticket and tagging infra for ratecap heuristics.
carla: one action item — add the `migration.mode` check to the worker readme and ensure operators can flip it from the console.
maria: noted, will add to runbook.
(20m after cutover)
ben: metrics look stable. closing the thread. :white_check_mark:
